name: FusionFix
description: Fixes a long list of bugs and technical shortcomings in GTA IV that were never patched, and adds settings for modern systems: a graphics menu of its own, working shadows and reflections, a frame limiter, restored cut content, and Vulkan through DXVK as an alternative to DirectX 9. The largest and most widely used mod for the game. NOT for 1.0.7.0: measured there, it corrupts the heap and takes the game down about ten seconds in. The project supports the Complete Edition only; of the older releases, 1.0.8.0 is the one people get it working on, and even that is unsupported by its authors and untested here.

sources.note: By ThirteenAG, from the project's own GitHub release - the same release the Legacy Addon in gfwl-stub comes from, so the two halves always match. 197 MB, mostly the update folder with textures and shaders. If the download fails: https://github.com/ThirteenAG/GTAIV.EFLC.FusionFix/releases, tag v5.0.1 - a later release has a different checksum and would be rejected, which is the point of the checksum.
